description: Set Japanese and other Asian composition on text frames: the Adobe Asian (Latin and CJK) composer, single-line or every-line; kinsoku shori and mojikumi sets (by the names the document defines) and the kinsoku order; and the character options tsume, aki, tate-chu-yoko and warichu

akiLeft.description: Aki before each character, in ems

akiRight.description: Aki after each character, in ems

composer.description: Use the Latin and CJK composer, single-line or every-line

kinsoku.description: Kinsoku shori set name, e.g. "Hard" or "Soft" (the document's sets are listed if the name is wrong)

kinsokuOrder.description: Kinsoku type: push in first, push out first, or push out only

mojikumi.description: Mojikumi set name (the document's sets are listed if the name is wrong)

target.description: Text frames (groups are searched for them). Give ids, names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tateChuYoko.description: Tate-chu-yoko: set the characters horizontally within vertical text

tsume.description: Tsume: % of space removed around each character

wariChu.description: Warichu: set the characters in smaller lines within one line

name: set_asian_type
title: Set Asian Type
